description: InnovaPower at the University of São Paulo publishes laboratory signals from synchronous generators operating with healthy windings and deliberately introduced electrical faults. The Generators-Dataset directory distinguishes a 2 kVA four-salient-pole machine at fixed and variable speeds and a 3 kVA four-smooth-pole machine at fixed speed. A subdirectory inventory confirms CSV measurement files labelled by fault and operating conditions. The current parent README describes time, current, voltage and mechanical measurements and identifies this release separately from its permanent-magnet and induction-generator datasets. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0, with an archived 2024 release on Zenodo. Temporal coverage and a common sample interval were not established from the inspected root documentation. The data come from controlled fault experiments, so their fault frequencies cannot be read as field failure rates. A reviewer-assessed use is validating generator-condition models or preparing equipment failure scenarios for model-pandapower. No electrical model was run and no measurement file was fetched.
name: InnovaPower synchronous-generator fault signals
